explication: ZombieBuddy is a Java agent framework for Project Zomboid modding. The main workflow is to start the agent with the game, discover and load Java mods, interpret their declarative patches, and transform game classes at runtime; it also exposes Java functionality to Lua. The README documents mod signing, installation, runtime retransformation, and logging as additional capabilities. Internal edges below rely on README-level descriptions where excerpts do not show the full call chain; experimental HTTP/Lua tooling is shown separately, with its wiring evidenced by the sampled sources.
